 Appearance:
 Shri Ritu Raj Bhatnagar, Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Vinod Thakur, Govt. Advocate for the respondent/
 Order

This second application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail in connection with Crime No.356/2024 registered at Police Station - Piploda, District- Ratlam(M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n),
506 of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 21.10.2024 as per arrest memo.

His earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 05.03.2025, passed in M.Cr.C. No.5630/2025 with liberty to revive the prayer after recording of the statement of the prosecutrix before the trial Court.
Heard the arguments.
Perused the grounds for grant of bail stated in the application, case diary and the relevant material on record.

Learned counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21071 2 MCRC-31802-2025 mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the alleged offence to pressurize the applicant to marry the victim.

Learned counsel refers to the DNA examination report, which reveals that the applicant is not biological father of new born child of the victim, to contend that the prosecution stands falsified in Arjun Damami vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26575499/
1 view of the unambiguous DNA examination report.

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that the applicant is aged around 29 years.
He is a labourer by profession.
Applicant enjoys good character and social reputation.
No criminal antecedents is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving the family and home.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant for the reason that the mother of victim(PW1) and victim(PW2) have been examined.
Jail incarceration of the applicant is causing hardship to the applicant and his dependent aged parents.
Applicant is ready to cooperate in the trial.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
However, after going through the case diary, he fairly states that no criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
According to the material available on case diary, applicant Arjun committed rape with the minor victim.
The victim got pregnant.
When the medical officer, on Sonograhy, informed that the victim is pregnant with six months, she narrated the incident to her mother and lodged the report.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted.
The trial is underway.
The DNA report contradicts the allegation of rape by applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:21071 3 MCRC-31802-2025
The veracity of prosecution will be determined after evidence in the trial.
As informed, the applicant is aged 29 years.
He is labourer by profession and has the responsibility of aged parents.
Considering these aspects, there appears to be no possibility of fleeing from justice.
In absence of any criminal past, considering the socio-economic status of the applicant, there appears to be no likelihood of tampering with evidence or influencing the witnesses by the applicant.
There appears to be no compelling reason to continue incarceration of the applicant.

However, the observations,
herein-above, are recorded for present application only.

Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances of the case, in the light of aforestated facts, but without commenting on the merits, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant-Arjun Damami shall be released on bail in connection with Crime No.356/2024 registered at Police Station - Piploda, District Ratlam(M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, for compliance with the following conditions :
(For convenience of understanding by accused and surety, the conditions of bail are also reproduced in Hindi as under):-
(1) Applicant shall remain present on every date of hearing as may be directed by the concerned court;
